nodes.name: Manual isolated test
nodes.notes: Whole-workflow isolated entry only, with all mutating schedules paused/drained.

nodes.name: Poll inactive
nodes.notes: 60-second scheduled entry; owner activation requires reviewed manual import and native validation.

nodes.name: Read control
nodes.notes: Read up to two rows to expose missing/duplicate singleton control state.

nodes.name: Validate entry
nodes.notes: Validate one global row and typed context; malformed state stops before remote work.

nodes.name: Already held
nodes.notes: A busy row skips all work and preserves the previous execution hold.

nodes.name: Report existing hold

parameters.jsCode: return [{json: {status:'skipped_held', control:$input.first().json}}];

nodes.notes: Expose held diagnostic context without changing or releasing it.

nodes.name: Prepare acquisition
nodes.notes: Prepare execution ID, start time and nullable issue context for conditional acquisition.

nodes.name: Acquire control
nodes.notes: Conditionally set busy on idle global row. This is a serialized interlock, not a distributed lock.

nodes.name: Check acquire receipt
nodes.notes: Require exact acquisition receipt; failed/unknown acquisition prevents remote work.

nodes.name: Read acquired control
nodes.notes: Reread persisted row to verify acquisition rather than assuming update success.

nodes.name: Verify acquisition
nodes.notes: Require this execution owns the singleton busy row before GitHub calls.

nodes.name: Require acknowledged completion
nodes.notes: Only acknowledged success/no-work reaches release. Errors have no release edge.

nodes.name: Read before release
nodes.notes: Reread singleton to prevent release of another execution hold.

nodes.name: Verify release ownership
nodes.notes: Check execution/start/selected issue against acquired and completed context before release.

nodes.name: Release control
nodes.notes: Clear busy only, after acknowledged work. Building and diagnostic fields persist.

nodes.name: Check release receipt
nodes.notes: Verify busy=false receipt and unchanged execution/issue context; uncertainty is not success.

nodes.name: Read released control
nodes.notes: Reread persistence to confirm idle instead of trusting the update receipt alone.

nodes.name: Confirm idle
nodes.notes: Require confirmed idle singleton with unchanged diagnostics before reporting completion.

nodes.name: Report completion

parameters.jsCode: return [{json: {status:'released', outcome:$('Require acknowledged completion').first().json.outcome, control:$input.first().json}}];

nodes.notes: Report acknowledged outcome and confirmed row; this does not confirm manual Codex launch.

nodes.name: Discover all issues
nodes.notes: Read every issue, including closed/non-owner Building conflicts. Pagination failures hold the acquired guard.

nodes.name: Select candidate
nodes.notes: Any Building issue blocks selection. Otherwise choose the lowest-numbered open owner Approved task. Malformed approval states fail closed.

nodes.name: Have candidate
nodes.notes: No candidate or occupied slot uses acknowledged no-work release; a candidate proceeds to approval evidence checks.

nodes.name: No work
nodes.notes: Release only this execution interlock. Existing Building reservations persist.

nodes.name: Read approval events
nodes.notes: Read complete label history. Require current owner Approved event, not assignment or inferred approval.

nodes.name: Read approved comments
nodes.notes: Read refinement/captured source and prior handoff evidence. Later session comments do not enter the captured digest.

nodes.name: Validate approval
nodes.notes: Validate latest unedited refinement and owner event ID/actor/time, captured source digest and absence of a handoff for this attempt. Missing/edited history holds, never approves.

nodes.name: Set issue context
nodes.notes: Set diagnostic issue only while this execution owns the busy row. Failure retains hold.

nodes.name: Check issue context
nodes.notes: Confirm singleton update receipt and ownership before any GitHub mutation.

nodes.name: Read PR baseline
nodes.notes: Capture same-repository issue-N/main PR numbers, head SHAs and states, including old closed results for later rework discrimination.

nodes.name: Recheck slot
nodes.notes: Repeat whole-repository slot discovery immediately before transition to detect intervening reservations. A changed slot stops held for inspection.

nodes.name: Recheck issue
nodes.notes: Re-read open/author/labels/title/body immediately before transition; do not trust discovery snapshot.

nodes.name: Recheck events
nodes.notes: Re-read approval event to detect removal/reapproval before reservation.

nodes.name: Recheck comments
nodes.notes: Re-read captured inputs, refinement and handoffs to detect source/history edits before mutation.

nodes.name: Prepare handoff
nodes.notes: Require unchanged approval/source and free slot. Freeze deterministic attempt metadata and PR baseline before writes; no automatic repair.

nodes.name: Add Building
nodes.notes: Reserve before manual launch by adding Building first. No retry on unknown response; partial transition holds for manual recovery.

nodes.name: Check Building receipt
nodes.notes: Confirm both source and target labels in addition receipt. Unrelated labels are preserved by additive operations.

nodes.name: Remove Approved
nodes.notes: Remove only Approved after acknowledged Building addition. Never adds Approved or replaces unrelated labels.

nodes.name: Check removal receipt
nodes.notes: Require sole Building state; uncertain removal leaves busy and reservation for owner reconciliation.

nodes.name: Before post issue
nodes.notes: Confirm reserved issue still open, owner-authored and solely Building before proceeding.

nodes.name: Before post events
nodes.notes: Confirm original owner approval and acknowledged removal still define this attempt; newer history holds.

nodes.name: Before post comments
nodes.notes: Check refinement/source and handoff comment evidence again; edits must not silently authorize changed scope.

nodes.name: Before post validation
nodes.notes: Revalidate exact approval/refinement/source snapshot. Only confirmed consistent reservation and handoff may release busy.

nodes.name: Post handoff
nodes.notes: Post one marked handoff keyed by approval event. Unknown POST outcome holds; never retry blindly or launch an agent.

nodes.name: Check handoff receipt
nodes.notes: Require created-comment status, ID, expected actor and exact body before final readback.

nodes.name: Final issue
nodes.notes: Confirm reserved issue still open, owner-authored and solely Building before proceeding.

nodes.name: Final events
nodes.notes: Confirm original owner approval and acknowledged removal still define this attempt; newer history holds.

nodes.name: Final comments
nodes.notes: Check refinement/source and handoff comment evidence again; edits must not silently authorize changed scope.

nodes.name: Final validation
nodes.notes: Revalidate exact approval/refinement/source snapshot. Only confirmed consistent reservation and handoff may release busy.

parameters.content:
## 1. Acquire execution guard

Skip existing holds; acquire and verify before remote work.

## 2. Select and validate approval

All Building issues block. Owner approval and exact captured source are mandatory.

## 3. Reserve and post handoff

Recheck before writes; add Building, remove Approved, post/read back handoff. Unknown effects retain busy. No launcher.

## 4. Release acknowledged execution

Release short-lived busy only after acknowledged success/no-work. Building survives restart and delayed launch.

## US2 inactive import handoff
Owner reviews JSON in PR and manually imports. Map every Data Table to the SAME isolated control table and each HTTP node to saved GitHub Authorization header credential. No Gemini credential needed. Never execute individual mutation nodes. See evidence/manual-build-validation.md; native/live T019 remains required.
